name: Structurize Fabric 26.3 (Unofficial)
description: An unofficial port of Structurize to the Fabric loader on Minecraft 26.3. The mod itself is the work of the LDT Team; this port is not affiliated with, endorsed by or supported by them. An astonishing way to copy & paste structures! Allows you to save structures of your choice into a file of small size, load them back and place them anywhere anytime, create various shapes using math formulas, and many other nice things a great builder would love to have.
